stem_md: $x=t\cos t,y=t\sin t$，求 $t=\frac\pi2$ 处切线方程。
analysis_md:
解答方程组两边同时对 $t$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=\cos t-t\sin t,\quad \frac{dy}{dt}=\sin t+t\cos t,\quad \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left.\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left.\frac{\sin t+t\cos t}{\cos t-t\sin t}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{2}}=-\frac{2}{\pi}.$$

带入初值可得 $y\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2},x\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=0$ 则切线方程为 $y-\frac{\pi}{2}=-\frac{\pi}{2}x$

$$\frac{dx}{dt}=\cos t-t\sin t,\quad \frac{dy}{dt}=\sin t+t\cos t,\quad \left.\frac{dy}{dx}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left.\frac{dy/dt}{dx/dt}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{2}}=\left.\frac{\sin t+t\cos t}{\cos t-t\sin t}\right|_{t=\frac{\pi}{2}}=-\frac{2}{\pi}.$$

带入初值可得 $y\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=\frac{\pi}{2},x\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=0$ 则切线方程为 $y-\frac{\pi}{2}=-\frac{\pi}{2}x$
